Your Tasks
 * Being part of SQUER means being a Team Leader, acting as a role model as well as being someone that is actively shaping SQUER.

 * You are responsible for the consultation on process changes around software development, software release and organizational improvements.

 * You understand the technical aspects of our solutions, which helps in effective communication with engineers and in making informed technical decisions.
 * Instead of acting as a lone fighter, you are happy to share your knowledge with your colleagues as a sparring partner and coach.

Your Qualifications
 * You have experience in agile software development projects and feel passionate and motivated about supporting software teams in all their disciplines.
 * You have strong communication skills, experience in stakeholder management and client relation management.
 * Analytical thinking and strong solution orientation is one of your core strengths. You know Lean and Agile Frameworks and bring deep knowledge in Requirements Engineering or Product Discovery.

 * You actively use AI-powered tools (e.g., code assistants, LLM-based workflows) to amplify your productivity and quality, or you're eager to start.
 * Fluent communication in German and English is no problem for you.

Your Benefits

 * Ownership & Responsibility: at SQUER, we believe in empowering our team. In our flat hierarchies, your ideas and actions matter more than titles. Take the reins, make an impact and grow with us.
 * Learn & Grow: Tap into a € 5.000 annual training budget to sharpen your skills and take advantage of our in-house Leadership Academy. Join and be part of our active tech community through meetups, hackathons and training sessions. Get up to 40h/year additional time off for your personal education.
 * Exciting Challenges & Real Impact: Dive into diverse projects where your work truly makes a difference - for our clients and for SQUER.
 * Flexibility for Performance: Benefit from hybrid work options, flexible hours, workations within the EU, and additional vacation days - giving you the freedom to perform at your best.
 * Tailored Tools for Success: Choose your preferred hardware configuration and leverage our suite of AI tools and licenses (Anthropic, OpenAI, and more) to suit your working style.
 * We Value You: Beyond perks and benefits, we offer a competitive annual salary to recognize your exceptional contributions.
 * Be Part of a Thriving Team Culture: At SQUER, collaboration and connection are at the heart of what we do. Through open communication, shared successes, and meaningful team events - including our annual SQUER offsite - we cultivate a culture where everyone feels valued and inspired to grow together.

Our employees are our most valuable asset, which is why we honour their exceptional work with not only a variety of benefits, but also a fair annual salary starting at € 75.000,- including over time - with the possibility of overpayment depending on qualifications and experience.
